questions.question: Bob in staff, file 640. Bob's class?
questions.explanation: Order: owner? group? other? Exactly one applies.

questions.question: Bob write on 640?
questions.explanation: Group bits r--: read yes, write no.

questions.question: Root write on 000?
questions.explanation: uid 0 bypasses permission bits (caps retire this).

questions.question: Non-root raw disk needs?
questions.explanation: Depth: perms say whose, caps say may-what.

questions.question: setuid passwd means?
options: Runs as file owner (borrowed root, fenced minute)
questions.explanation: Borrowed identity for one call: sharpest Unix door.

questions.question: 0640 -> 0660 moves whom?
questions.explanation: One octal digit moves a whole class.
